{{Translated title}} [[File:Archeologists HZ037.png|thumb|250px|The archeologists]] These (Japanese: '''N/A''' ''archeologists'') are [[character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HZ037|Fuecoco…Becomes a Crook?!]]''. ==History== The archaeologists, whose scholar was an old acquaintance of [[Friede]], hired the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] to move large boulders and try to lose a family of {{p|Krookodile}} and {{p|Krokorok}} who, according to them, destroyed their equipment for no reason, preventing them from continuing their excavations. However, after [[Roy]] and {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}} fell into a pit, they discovered that beneath the ruins lied the Pokémon's nest, whose {{p|Sandile|pups}} were scared away from drilling noises. Angry, Krookodile and the Krokorok returned to the surface to attack the archaeologists, but they were calmed down after Fuecoco learned {{m|Disarming Voice}}. Having cleared up the misunderstanding, the archaeologists agreed with the Pokémon family to continue the work without disturbing them anymore. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Archeologist |pkmn=Luxray |type1=Electric |img=Archeologist Luxray.png |epnum=HZ037 |epname=Fuecoco…Becomes a Crook?! |vajp=Kohsuke Tanabe |vaen= |desc={{p|Luxray}} is the archeologists' first known Pokémon. Luxray was used to keep lookout and alerted the group when it detected a group of {{p|Krokorok}} and {{p|Krookodile}} nearby. None of Luxray's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Archeologist |pkmn=Diggersby |type1=Normal |type2=Ground |img=Archeologist Diggersby.png |epnum=HZ037 |epname=Fuecoco…Becomes a Crook?! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Diggersby}} is the archeologists' second known Pokémon. Diggersby was used to help excavate the ground where the group were digging. It was used to battle a group of {{p|Krokorok}}, only to be defeated by a {{p|Krookodile}}. Diggersby's only known move is {{m|Hammer Arm}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Archeologist |pkmn=Minccino |type1=Normal |img=Archeologist Minccino.png |epnum=HZ037 |epname=Fuecoco…Becomes a Crook?! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Minccino}} is the archeologists' third known Pokémon. Minccino was used to help clear the sand from where the group were digging. It was used to battle a group of {{p|Krokorok}}, only to be defeated by another Krokorok.
